caption: A plastic shopping bag lying on an empty parking lot inflates and tumbles away across the lot as the wind rises.

sa.check: A plastic shopping bag lies on an empty parking lot.
It tumbles away across the lot.
The bag inflates first and then tumbles.

pc.expect: The bag moves as the wind picks up and not before.
pc.fail: It moves before any sign of wind; or keeps moving steadily after the wind drops; or jumps.

pc.expect: It moves downwind, rising and dipping with the gusts.
pc.fail: It moves against the wind; or in a straight line at constant height; or crosswise to other wind signs.

pc.expect: It dips back to the ground between gusts.
pc.fail: It rises indefinitely; or hangs; or rolls along without lifting.

pc.expect: It fills with air, flaps and crumples.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or tears into strips; or stays flat while moving.

pc.expect: One bag keeps its number and passes through nothing.
pc.fail: It duplicates; or passes through a kerb; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The bag's colour and the lot stay the same.
pc.fail: The bag changes colour; or the lot markings shift; or the surroundings rearrange.
